name: renal tubular acidosis, distal, 4, with hemolytic anemia
description: Distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) with anemia is a very rare form of distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) characterized by a defect in renal acidification and hereditary hemolytic anemia.
